text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, while Taiki Shuttle is training<n>hard for the
upcoming Mile<n>Championship...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hm? It's awful lively over there. Are<n>they havin' a
barbecue or<n>something?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, there appears to be a<n>group of
reporters crowded together.<n>On closer inspection...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Your latest performance was nothing<n>short of
fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
An absolutely magnificent display!<n>Especially in a
situation like that,<n>where you couldn't have
imagined<n>you'd win!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, I couldn't have<n>imagined I'd
win? There's no such<n>race in this world.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the Empress, I exemplify<n>perfection in all
situations. I simply did<n>exactly what needed to be
done.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I'd expect no less from you! What anintimidat—I mean, impressive way oflooking at things!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Will that be all the questions for<n>today? If so, I'll be
taking my leave.<n>This is cutting into my training time.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Please, just a moment! Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow, she's so popular! That's Air<n>Groove for ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm real proud to have her as a<n>friend!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has performed<n>exceptionally well in a
number of G1<n>races.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You said it! I ain't lettin' anybody get<n>in the way of
me becoming<n>Umamusume of the Year—not even<n>my
friends!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay, back to training! I gotta focus<n>and run like I
really mean it!
choice_data_list: (Hm? Suddenly, I've got a bad feeling...)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, look what cat dragged in!<n>Howdy, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki loses focus immediately, leaving<n>me to chase
after her.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You training, Suzuka? Why don't I<n>join ya?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You're running in the Mile<n>Championship, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You bet! It's the one race where I can<n>go toe to toe
with the seniors!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Then unfortunately, I can't train with<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?! Say it ain't so, Suzuka! Why<n>not?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've decided to enter the Mile<n>Championship
myself...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No way! Really?! You're gonna be<n>there too?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's why... Hm, how should I<n>put this?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You see, I've been rethinking the<n>way I run.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh... Not sure I follow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to try out different<n>approaches... in many
different races.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, Silence Suzuka scored<n>a win against
Air Groove with her<n>"runaway" style.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this is one of the things<n>she's discovered
on her journey.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I'm almost there. I feel like I just<n>need a little
more to get within reach.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
This time, I want to experience the<n>fast pace of a
sprint in the Mile<n>Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to understand Silence<n>Suzuka's
mindset.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In any case, we've got no choice but<n>to err on the
side of caution.
choice_data_list: The seniors aren't your only rivals.
The seniors aren't your only rivals.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You said it! I ain't plannin' on losing,<n>Suzuka! That
number one spot is<n>mine!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I feel the exact same way. I<n>mean to win.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo, I'm feelin' pumped now!<n>Let's put this
energy into training!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You ready, Suzuka? Time for one lap<n>at full speed!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Taiki. Were you listening to<n>me? I said I
can't train with my<n>rivals—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Aw, forget about that! Let's run,<n>Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You're kidding, right?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thus, we've learned that Silence<n>Suzuka will be
competing in the Mile<n>Championship along with
Taiki<n>Shuttle.
